description: Payment Status Report: Instructing Agent must be a Financial Institution Identification.
Payment Status Report: Instructed Agent must be a Financial Institution Identification.
Group Status (GrpSts) must be a valid ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus code.
Transaction Status (TxSts) must be a valid ExternalPaymentTransactionStatus code.
If TxSts = RJCT, StsRsnInf is mandatory.
expression: VALUE != 'RJCT' or any(k.startswith(KEY.rsplit('.TxSts',1)[0] + '.StsRsnInf') for k in DATA.keys())
errorMessage: When TxSts = RJCT, a <StsRsnInf> block with the rejection reason is mandatory.

description: If TxSts = PDNG, StsRsnInf should be present to explain the pending reason.
expression: VALUE != 'PDNG' or any(k.startswith(KEY.rsplit('.TxSts',1)[0] + '.StsRsnInf') for k in DATA.keys())
errorMessage: When TxSts = PDNG, providing <StsRsnInf> explaining the pending reason is recommended.
fix: Consider adding <StsRsnInf> with reason code PD01/PD02/PD03/etc.

description: Status Reason Code must be a valid ISO 20022 status reason code.
Original Message ID is mandatory in OrgnlGrpInfAndSts.
Original Message Name ID is mandatory.
Either OrgnlGrpInfAndSts or TxInfAndSts must be present (status reports must reference an original).
errorMessage: A status report (pacs.002) must reference an original via <OrgnlGrpInfAndSts> or <TxInfAndSts>.
fix: Add at least one of these blocks pointing to the original message being reported on.

name: PACS002_CreDtTm_Date_Format_Invalid
description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm contains an invalid ISO 8601 datetime. Common errors: 'Z' suffix, milliseconds (.123), missing timezone offset.
errorMessage: GrpHdr/CreDtTm has an invalid datetime format. Must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM (no Z, no milliseconds).
fix: Replace with a valid ISO 8601 datetime. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 (e.g. 2026-06-09T10:00:00+00:00). Never use 'Z' suffix or milliseconds.

name: PACS002_AppHdr_CreDt_Format_Invalid
description: AppHdr/CreDt contains an invalid datetime. Must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. Z suffix and milliseconds are forbidden under CBPR+.
errorMessage: AppHdr/CreDt has an invalid datetime format. Must be YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM (no Z, no milliseconds).
fix: Replace with a valid ISO 8601 datetime with timezone. Example: 2026-06-09T10:00:00+00:00.

name: PACS002_Character_Set_Usage
description: All text values must comply with the CBPR+ permitted character set. Standard fields: A-Z a-z 0-9 space /\-?:().,'+. Extended fields (Nm, Adr, RmtInf): additionally !#$&%*=^_{{|}}~";<>@[\]. Use < for < and > for >.
expression: all(re.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9 /\-?:().,\'+]*$', str(v)) for k, v in DATA.items() if isinstance(v, str) and not k.endswith('@Ccy') and not k.endswith('@Tp') and not re.search(r'(IBAN|BIC|LEI|UETR|MsgId|BizMsgIdr|CreDtTm|IntrBkSttlmDt|Nm|AdrLine|StrtNm|TwnNm|Ustrd|AddtlInf)', k))
errorMessage: Character set used does not comply with CBPR+ UHB specifications. Only A-Z a-z 0-9 space and /\-?:().,\' are permitted in standard fields. Nm/Adr/RmtInf fields allow extended charset including !#$&%*=^_{{|}}~";<>@[\].
fix: Remove characters outside the CBPR+ permitted set. For Nm/Adr/RmtInf fields use the extended charset. Replace < with < and > with >.
